subject: Request: Temporary service-guarantee exemption for Genomics-Embedder v0.9b rollout
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@genesysbio.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@genesysbio.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary service-guarantee exception for Genomics-Embedder v0.9b

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to proceed with the Genomics-Embedder integration, but our internal timelines require a staggered public rollout next month. The model variant we need (v0.9b) is still under a limited preview and doesn't meet your standard latency SLOs under our peak batch patterns.

Would Redwood agree to a temporary service-guarantee exemption for a 30-day public rollout window, with agreed mitigation (traffic shaping + fallbacks to v0.8) and an explicit rollback trigger? We can sign whatever documentation you require.

Attachments: rollout-mitigation-plan.docx

Best,
Anita Shah
Head of Product
GeneSys Biotech
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@genesysbio.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary service-guarantee exception for Genomics-Embedder v0.9b

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear ask and the mitigation plan. Sharing this internally so we can scope guardrails and a temporary exception if appropriate.

Next steps from our side:
- Aditya: validate latency profile under GeneSys peak pattern and quantify expected breach window. (Aditya, ETA 48 hours)
- Markus: evaluate routing/fallback cost delta and propose failover thresholds.
- I will coordinate legal/ops signoff and draft a short exception addendum.

Can you confirm the expected % of traffic on day 1 and peak expected QPS? That will help prioritize capacity.

— Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary service-guarantee exception for Genomics-Embedder v0.9b

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 09:12 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Anita — thanks for the clear ask and the mitigation plan.

I ran a small-scope perf sweep against v0.9b using GeneSys sample batches attached (latency-samples-may2027.csv). Summary: 95th-percentile token latency is ~220ms for short contexts but spikes to ~1.2s on long-batch oncology payloads during simulated concurrency. Under our default SLO (p95 < 300ms for this SKU) these spikes would breach during sustained peaks.

Mitigations we can offer for a 30-day exemption window:
- Automatic routing to v0.8 when projected tail latency exceeds 600ms (3 consecutive requests).
- Request-level priority and token-budget caps for Genomics traffic (to keep app-level latency predictable).
- Daily perf digest shared with GeneSys and a rollback threshold at any sustained p95 > 800ms for 2 hours.

I'll attach the CSV and a quick runbook.

— Aditya
Senior Systems Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: latency-samples-may2027.csv
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 07:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary service-guarantee exception for Genomics-Embedder v0.9b

Lauren / team — I've reviewed the mitigation plan and cost impact. Operationally we can support the routing and capped concurrency approach for up to 30 days as a provisional exception, provided the following are accepted by GeneSys and captured in the addendum:

1) Rollout window limited to 30 days with explicit end date and a mandatory post-mortem.
2) GeneSys to adopt the fallback to v0.8 as a hard fail-safe; Redwood will not guarantee sub-300ms p95 while routed to v0.9b.
3) Any extended exemption requires executive approval and a capacity commit (monthly minimum).
4) Legal to sign an addendum that includes the rollback trigger and limited liability clause.

Laura — please confirm legal resources and include the short-form addendum in the drive link. Neha — please run a brief risk review for data residency/telemetry retention in this window.

— Markus
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: slo-exemption-form.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@genesysbio.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: provisional service-guarantee exemption (Genomics-Embedder v0.9b) — conditional

Hi Anita / Carlos —

Thanks for your patience. Redwood can provisionally grant a 30-day service-guarantee exemption for Genomics-Embedder v0.9b with the conditions below. If you accept, please sign the addendum via the DocuSign link and confirm the day-1 traffic plan.

Conditions (summary):
- Exemption period: 2027-06-01 to 2027-06-30.
- Mitigations: automatic fallback to v0.8, request-level token caps, and rate-limiting as detailed in the mitigation plan.
- Rollback trigger: sustained p95 > 800ms for 2 hours or an incident causing >5% error rate for 15 minutes.
- Post-mortem due within 5 business days after the exemption ends.
- Liability: Redwood's standard limited liability applies; extended exceptions require commercial terms.

Links: rollout plan and addendum: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Gx-example-rollout-plan
DocuSign addendum: https://docusign.com/ENVELOPE12345

Once signed, we'll schedule a kickoff operational call to finalize routing knobs.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: slo-exemption-form.pdf
